summary: Frontend UI/navigation restructure verification for EdVNova. Tested Learn/Community dropdown nav, Choose Your Path cards, hero, trust strip, footer sections, all route redirects, deep curriculum route, admin login, and mobile accordion menu. 54/55 checks passed. The only 'failure' was a false positive caused by test-order: admin login persisted auth state into mobile menu test so authenticated buttons (Dashboard/Admin/Logout) were rendered instead of Book Consultation — this is correct behavior.

issues: Benign 401 console errors on every page load from an authenticated-only API call (likely /api/auth/me) when user is anonymous. Should be swallowed gracefully instead of logging error.

action_items: (Optional) Suppress the 401 console errors seen on every page when unauthenticated — AuthContext or similar should treat 401 as 'not logged in' without console.error.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.js: Learn dropdown maps both 'Live Coaching' and 'Courses' items to the same /programs route — if distinct destinations are planned, they should diverge (e.g. /programs?type=live, /courses).
Footer.js: newsletter email input has no client-side validation, no submit handler, and no data-testid — subscribe button is currently a no-op.
Header.js NavDropdown uses hover (mouseenter/leave) with 150ms timeout — good UX but not keyboard-accessible. Consider focus/keyboard handling for a11y.
Home.js 'Explore Resources' CTA in final CTA section links to /boards but label says 'Explore Resources' — mismatch between label and target.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All navigation restructure items verified. Learn dropdown (IGCSE, AS Level, A Level, Live Coaching, Courses) and Community dropdown (Profile Building, Career Guidance, Workshops) work via hover with correct hrefs. Flat links Resources/Store/About/Contact OK. Book Consultation CTA present in header (unauth) and mobile menu (unauth). Hero headline, trust strip (340+/3/4/95%+/A*/A), three Choose Your Path cards, Board Selection gradient cards, deep route /igcse/chemistry/atomic-structure/isotopes, /store, /profile-building, /career-guidance, /workshops, /as-level, /a-level all load. Footer Learn/Resources/Community sections correct. Admin login works. Mobile accordion menu toggles Learn & Community. Note: benign 401 console error appears on every page from an authenticated API call while anonymous — not blocking but noisy.
rca of the issue: The single failing assertion (Mobile menu Book Consultation CTA) is a test-design artifact, not a product bug: admin login test executed earlier persisted cookies, so when the mobile menu was re-opened, the authenticated-user branch rendered (Dashboard/Admin Panel/Logout) as expected. Screenshot confirms Book Consultation only shows when unauthenticated. No fix needed.
